title: Scientists were wrong about this strange mammal for nearly 40 years

Tamirkhan balcarceli shows that zhelestids were not early relatives of modern placental mammals, despite having teeth that seemed to suggest they were. Instead, the rabbit-like animal belonged to a separate lineage of small Cretaceous mammals.

title: James Webb reveals why planet formation is a race against time

title: Pomegranate compound improves heart function by up to 80% in study

title: Scientists found a surprising driver of Alzheimer’s outside the brain

title: Resetting the body clock could help the brain recover after stroke

title: Under the Microscope: NASA-made material for moon manufacturing
description: Photos taken using a microscope reveal the colorful, kaleidoscope-like crystal structure of a new NASA-made material that could be used for manufacturing during future space missions. Developed at NASA's Glenn Research Center in Cleveland, the material could be created directly on the moon or Mars, allowing NASA to pack fewer supplies—saving weight and reducing launch costs.

title: Mobile crisis response programs get new measures of their impact on police calls

description: UN Special Envoy Hans Grundberg concluded three days of talks in Cairo on Wednesday, meeting Egyptian and Arab League officials to discuss the military escalation in Yemen and its regional repercussions, as fighting between government forces and Houthis displaces nearly 180,000 people.

title: US, coalition partners end 12-year military mission in Iraq: Pentagon
description: The Pentagon announced Wednesday that the United States and coalition partners have formally concluded Operation Inherent Resolve in Iraq, marking the end of a 12-year campaign that defeated ISIS and the transition to an Iraqi-led security framework supported by bilateral cooperation.

title: Will the October 7 dossier spell the end of Netanyahu?
description: In his UN General Assembly speech, Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu tried to put on stage once again the image on which he built his political platform: the indispensable statesman who can protect an Israel "surrounded by enemies" by defying the entire world. However, the fact that he had to return to his country as soon as he finished his speech shows that the political picture—both inside Israe…

title: "They think it's a genocide because they don't know the Bible"
description: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee made an interesting statement after the rate of Americans expressing negative views about Israel in recent public opinion polls rose to around 60 percent. Speaking to Chicago-based NewsNation television, Huckabee said that anti-Israel sentiment in American public opinion stems from three main reasons: "The first reason for the decline in support for Israel is…

title: Pilot fight triggers hijacking alert on Dubai-Tel Aviv flight
description: An altercation between the pilots of a commercial flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv reportedly triggered an emergency hijacking code on Wednesday, forcing the aircraft to divert to Tabuk Airport in northwestern Saudi Arabia instead of its scheduled destination, according to Israeli daily Ynet.

title: Global markets mixed as US Treasury yields hit multi-year highs
description: Global equity markets traded mixed on Tuesday as US Treasury yields climbed to multi-decade peaks, with the 10-year rate touching 5.3% and investors positioning for crucial gross domestic product and inflation data expected to shape Federal Reserve policy decisions in the coming months.

title: Türkiye's unemployment rate drops to 7.8% in August
description: The Turkish Statistical Institute announced that Türkiye's unemployment rate dropped to 7.8% in August from 8.1% the previous month, with the number of unemployed people falling by 106,000 to 2.74 million while employment rose by 136,000.

title: Flydubai flight to Tel Aviv transmits hijacking code, diverts
description: A Flydubai flight carrying more than 150 passengers transmitted a distress code indicating a possible hijacking and diverted toward Saudi Arabia on Wednesday, prompting Israeli fighter jets to scramble and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to convene an urgent security consultation after contact was lost.

title: Türkiye joins fishing tournament near Russia nuclear plant
description: Anglers from 12 countries, including Türkiye, gathered on Lake Udomlya in Russia for an international fishing tournament organized by Rosatom. Held beside the Kalinin Nuclear Power Plant, the event highlights environmental monitoring and ecosystem conditions around nuclear facilities while bringing together participants from Europe, Asia, Africa and Türkiye. Anglers from Türkiye and 11 other coun…

title: Netanyahu meets UAE president in expanded talks with 10 nations
description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan held an expanded meeting in Abu Dhabi attended by officials from 10 countries, focusing on regional security cooperation and defense frameworks against shared threats and alternative oil routes, according to Israeli media.

title: Trump orders federal use of 'super intelligence' over 'AI'
description: President Donald Trump signed an executive order Tuesday directing federal agencies to replace the term "artificial intelligence" with "super intelligence" in official executive branch communications, with the White House stating the change recognizes the "immense opportunity" presented by continuously advancing technologies.

title: Cuba blames US blockade as Rubio calls island 'failed state'
description: Cuban Foreign Minister Bruno Rodriguez accused Washington on Tuesday of tightening its economic blockade against Havana through new measures targeting academic exchanges and private sector transactions, while US Secretary of State Marco Rubio described the island as a "failed state" suffering from severe economic deterioration.

title: UN Security Council holds fourth straw poll to pick next chief
description: French UN envoy Jerome Bonnafont confirmed the fourth non-binding straw poll has concluded as the race to succeed Secretary-General Antonio Guterres intensifies, with seven candidates vying for the post before a formal recommendation moves to the General Assembly.

title: Iraq announces end of US-led coalition military mission
description: Iraq announced the formal conclusion of the US-led international coalition's military mission on Wednesday, confirming that American forces completed their withdrawal from remaining positions this month as Baghdad marks a transition to bilateral security relations with coalition member states aimed at consolidating Iraqi sovereignty.

title: US ends 23-year military presence in Iraq after long conflict
description: The United States is completing its military withdrawal from Iraq after a 23-year presence that began with the 2003 invasion. Baghdad and Washington agreed in 2024 to phase out the US-led coalition’s military mission, transferring primary responsibility for ground operations to Iraqi forces while preserving the possibility of limited bilateral security cooperation and air support against Daesh.

title: US Navy awards Boeing $20B contract for sixth-generation fighter
description: The Pentagon announced on Tuesday that the US Navy has awarded Boeing a contract worth more than $20 billion for the full-scale development of the sixth-generation F/A-XX strike fighter, with officials stating the platform will dominate contested airspace and extend carrier fleet operational reach.

title: Cotton urges Pentagon chief to review F-35 supply chain security
description: Republican Senator Tom Cotton called on Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Tuesday to conduct a comprehensive review of military supply chain security, warning that F-35 components shipped from Australia to the United States were diverted to Hong Kong and seized by Chinese authorities, exposing critical vulnerabilities in contractor-managed transportation networks.

title: Israeli strikes kill Gaza woman, injure 5 despite ceasefire
description: Medical sources in Gaza said a Palestinian woman was killed and five others were injured in Israeli attacks targeting multiple areas of the coastal enclave on Wednesday, bringing the cumulative death toll from ceasefire violations to more than 1,400 since October.

title: DoorDash opens first India office in Hyderabad, plans to scale tech, support team to 3,000
description: DoorDash is starting with 500 professionals and plans to scale its headcount to more than 3,000 within the next two years, a company release said.

title: Not unicorns, lifelines: 5 Northeast startups building for problems they grew up with
description: Meet five Northeast startups building solutions for electricity, healthcare, water, language and accessibility challenges across the region.

title: Startup news and updates: daily roundup (September 30, 2026)
description: YourStory presents the daily news roundup from the Indian startup ecosystem and beyond. Here's the roundup for September 30, 2026.

title: Inox Clean Energy files papers for Rs 10,000-cr IPO
description: This offering would mark the largest private-sector renewable energy public issue in India to date.

title: Karnataka approves Global Technology Centres in Belagavi and Hubballi
description: Karnataka approves Global Technology Centres in Belagavi and Hubballi as the state expands its tech ecosystem beyond Bengaluru.

title: EV two-wheeler maker Simple Energy bags Rs 1,750 Cr funding
description: The Bengaluru-based firm plans to deploy the capital to drive its next phase of growth across manufacturing, product development, and retail.

title: TDB backs 22 projects under Rs 1 lakh Cr RDI Fund, says industrialist Sudhir Mehta
description: The first cohort comprises 22 projects involving Rs 4,744 crore in R&D and Rs 2,192 crore in funding from the RDI Fund.
